scope: Logical multi-producer R2 candidate ingress and opaque delivery-context ownership contract. No behavioral R2 rewrite, physical ingress port count, FIFO depth, scheduler, R1 path, payload movement, controller, timing, PPA, model/GPU, or new A4 DSE claim.

retains: grant cursor advance only on R1 acceptance

logical_ingress.name: R2CandidateIngressByClass
logical_ingress.producer_to_consumer: one class-labelled producer endpoint -> route_a_core_side_arbiter per frozen class
logical_ingress.context_rule: a producer obtains and binds one immutable delivery_context_ref before presenting a candidate; R2 transports but never decodes it
logical_ingress.same_opportunity_rule: when more than one eligible logical ingress is presented at one abstract acceptance opportunity, R2 selects only by the existing frozen candidate ordering and predicates; no top/adapter selection is permitted
logical_ingress.physical_boundary: the six class-labelled logical ingress records do not select a physical FIFO count, bus count, arbitration microarchitecture, service rate, or port count

delivery_context_registry.name: route_a_delivery_context_registry
owns: one live immutable delivery context for each R2-presented candidate
exact target descriptor until final R1 terminal or destructive reset
delivery_context_registry.lifetime: allocate before candidate presentation; immutable through R2/R1; resolve only after matching R1 terminal; free only after target acceptance or destructive reset

carriers.rule: registry returns a fresh opaque ref only while no live identical identity/ref association exists
candidate is immutable and contains the ref returned by its registry allocation
only accepted eligible R2 candidate reaches the sole R1 path
R2 emits the exact opaque ref and matching R1 response; no endpoint routing occurs in R2
registry resolves one exact live target; mismatch/stale/duplicate response is rejected without target mutation
the registry never synthesizes a terminal and releases its ref only after target acceptance

invariants: candidate_class is one of the six frozen logical classes and cannot be reclassified after producer presentation
arrival_ordinal and candidate_id are producer-originated immutable ordering fields; R2 alone applies the existing ordering rule
R2 ready-low cannot mutate an ingress candidate, context, cursor, ownership, credit, admission, or mask
a live delivery_context_ref is unique and cannot be reallocated until exact terminal target acceptance or destructive reset
a stale/unknown/mismatched response cannot resolve context, mutate S2/direct/P3/R5, make READY, or create terminal outcome
descriptor maintenance remains one FIFO-ordered 64-B write class through the same R1 path and never joins the read rotation

required_follow_on.requires: Add reviewed R2 logical class-ingress and context-registry interfaces before activating the R3 pack-write producer. The typed router later consumes only registry-resolved target descriptors.
required_follow_on.not_authorized: No physical ingress lanes/FIFO depths, cross-class performance arbitration, R1 controller behavior, endpoint payload storage, or typed delivery routing behavior is enabled by this closure.
